gen-orbitron-fs-supreme: Supreme sets a heavy, dense band of sans-serif text whose curves stay held open, never curling shut, beneath the heading. Orbitron is the precise one, spacing its letters far apart; Supreme packs in.
gen-orbitron-manrope: Manrope runs a plain sans line with bright gaps at every curve and hardly any step up to capitals. Orbitron's wide, spaced-out display letters make a crisp, futuristic partner.
gen-orbitron-satoshi: Tall, spacious and sharply minimal, this pairing sets Orbitron's far-apart letters over a soaring body. Satoshi keeps its e wide open and every stroke cut to one width, so the page stays easy on the eye.
gen-orbitron-work-sans: Orbitron spreads its letters far apart, each e showing a big, clear eye. And Work Sans follows with a modern sans whose c tips never creep toward touching and whose mean line sits high.
gen-poppins-fs-erode: Erode is a text serif with a tall middle band. Poppins sits against it with connected, pipe-cleaner strokes, and the gentle ebb and flow of Erode's stroke weight makes the difference between them clear.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-abeezee: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart like cut-outs. ABeeZee hums underneath as a plain sans with neon-tube thickness and clear terminals, so a longer passage reads smooth and soft.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-aldrich: Press Start 2P has big, open-looking lowercase bowls and a faint weight change you notice only up close, while Aldrich holds the text in a tight, cupped sans-serif. Retro fun meets modern crispness.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-alexandria: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart like cut-outs, with bowls that swell only slightly at their widest. Alexandria answers in a plain sans with wide open c terminals and short stems, tall and steady.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-amiko: Press Start 2P brings a fun, retro look, with thins barely lighter than thicks and letters pinned far apart. And Amiko, a modern sans with crayon-tall lowercase and outward-pointing terminals, gives it a sturdy counterpart.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati reads clean and approachable, its lowercase rivaling the capitals and its c opening wide, while Press Start 2P adds a retro, pinned-apart look up top. Their gap is the pair's hook.
